activities.name: Second Solaris: Dreams Untold
activities.description: Leisure event. Live a campus life in the Second Solaris: plan each week's schedule, take classes, do extracurricular work and part-time jobs to raise your stats, spend weekends with companions to unlock their stories, and choose a student council or club union path. Different choices lead to different story and companion endings.

activities.name: Lament of the Past
activities.description: Log in and check in during the event to claim the login rewards.

activities.name: Laelaro Cubes: Reverse
activities.description: Drag blocks onto the play area and fill rows or columns to clear them and earn points. Each stage group has Easy and Hard difficulties. A block rotation feature is newly added during the event.

activities.name: Echoing Realm
activities.description: During the event, consume Waveplates in Simulation Challenge and Forgery Challenge to claim double rewards.

activities.name: Dreamscape Odyssey
activities.description: Pick one main character and two support characters for consecutive challenges split into Boundary Stones and Nodes, choosing dream sediment at the start of each Boundary Stone. Remaining time keeps draining as the challenge goes on; defeating enemies and certain combat actions grant more time, and the more time left at the end, the higher the rating.

activities.name: Wuthering Exploration: Maintenance
activities.description: During the event, complete daily objectives to earn WuWu Mail Coins; spend one coin to randomly receive a special delivery.

activities.name: Where the Wind Leads
activities.description: Limited-Time Login Event. Log in after 04:00 (server time) each day during the event to accumulate login days and claim the rewards for the required total days.

activities.name: Chord Cleansing
activities.description: During the event, consume Waveplates in Tacet Suppression to claim double rewards.
